noah: Hey @auditor_kate 505 audit ask: can we provide deterministic evidence linking the 2026-10-02 RBAC changes to KMS key usage and the CI deploy? Need sampling instructions and chain-of-custody.

auditor_kate: Hi Noah 505 yes please. We want: rolebinding pre/post diffs, PR approval history, CI run IDs, KMS Encrypt/Decrypt request IDs, envelope_id & key_version for artifacts, and a README with exact commands to reproduce the sample. Hashing of principals OK if deterministic.

maya: I can export pre/post rolebinding snapshots and produce an aggregated JSON diff. We'll also keep raw namespace yamls. For hashing we'll use salted sha256 and include the salt file. Any preference for salt delivery?

auditor_kate: Include salt in the bundle but provide it out-of-band via support ticket DM. That satisfies verification without exposing raw PII. Also include mapping for service accounts vs human principals.

oscar: Note on KMS: CloudTrail gives kms.key_id and requestID; envelope_id lives in S3 object metadata for CI artifacts. I can correlate by artifact S3 key + requestID. I'll create a CSV with columns: timestamp,cloudtrail_request_id,kms_key_id,envelope_id,artifact_s3_key,principal_hash.

ops-bot: Export checklist: run `./compliance/export_bundle.sh --ticket=INC-2026-901 --salt=20261005-team` then sign bundle. Verify with `sha256sum`.

maya: We'll redact pod logs and secrets; raw yamls will have redaction markers. We'll also include vuln triage note: CVE-2026-0421 noted 2026-10-01, PR#4321 patched 2026-10-03. I'll attach the triage summary and the PR link.

auditor_kate: Good. For sampling window: +/- 48h around the deploy timestamp. Provide commands with exact epoch millis so we can rerun filters. Example CLI in README expected.

oscar: I'll prepare the CSV and manifest. ETA upload ~2.5h to s3://redwood-audit-working/1911112222/rbac-kms-bundle.tar.gz (7d expiry).

auditor_kate: Please also include the CI system's webhook request IDs and the git commit used for the deploy; we use that to tie artifacts to code.

maya: Adding webhook logs and pipeline metadata. We'll include a `replay.sh` with the exact aws/cloudtrail/ jq commands.

noah: Sounds good. We'll DM presigned link and salt to @auditor_kate once uploaded. Anything else?

auditor_kate: That's all for now. Might request a few raw yamls during review. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
